selection: 1-20 explicit concepts; every unit and period for each selected concept; reject absent/empty selected concepts

identity: payload CIK must equal verified binding CIK
period_type: duration when start exists; otherwise instant; canonical concept period type remains unknown
output: sourced raw financial observations; no canonical metrics, restatement precedence, annual selection or snapshot
digest_scope: this extraction contract descriptor, not executable parser code
